## Featured Research

:::: card
::: card-body
### The Price of Access

#### Evaluating the Australian Grand Prix's New Ticketing Strategy

**Commercial Strategy \| Pricing \| Revenue Modelling**

An independent assessment of the Australian Grand Prix's revised ticketing and membership strategy, exploring its implications for revenue, customer demand and long-term fan loyalty.

Using Excel financial modelling and R-based analysis, this project will evaluate the commercial trade-offs associated with the new model.

**Status:** Research in progress
